label: High threshold true
method: Synthetic inputs: 500 periods with 50 failures. A high threshold selects 60 inspections: 30 true and 30 false positives, giving 60% recall and 50% precision. A lower threshold selects 100: 40 true and 60 false positives, giving 80% recall and 40% precision. Forty extra inspections identify 10 more observed failures; prevention is not measured.
